Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand - Ravenna Home Single-Light Flush-Mount Ceiling Light with Frosted Glass Shade, 5.3"H, Bronze
Colors: Bronze
11"W x 11"D x 5.3"H Frosted glass shade, metal base in a bronze finish This stylish flush-mount ceiling light is ideal for any room with contemporary decor. The frosted glass shade creates the perfect spread of light. 1 60-watt E26 bulb required. Bulb not included. Assemble in 15-30 minutes For indoor use only.
